categories.label: Danmark i verden, geografi og klima

notes: 8 tests x 25 = 200, every item in exactly one test (pools exactly 8x each count), the real test's 25 questions and 20 to pass (passPct 80). Training: four topic sets 23901-23904 (hverdagsliv 48, arbejde og velfærd 56, demokrati og rettigheder 56, verden og kultur 40), so the dashboard is 4 sets + 8 tests = 12 steps. Categories follow the 26 fakta-ark of SIRI's Læremateriale til medborgerskabsprøven (August 2024); the 3/4/3/3/4/3/3/2 split is Tigertest's.
